site.name: LandDoctor
site.tagline: Verified land experts at fixed prices

home.title: What is your land problem?
home.intro: Verified surveyors and land experts look at your papers and tell you the right way forward. Prices known upfront, no middlemen.
home.servingNote: Phone advice is available from anywhere in Bangladesh.
home.orTalk: Prefer not to fill a form? Talk to us directly
steps: Tell us the problem, on the form or by phone
We understand it on a free 10-minute call
We send a fixed-price offer, with government fees listed separately
After payment, a verified expert starts the work
trust: Verified experts, members of the surveyors' association
Price known upfront, government fees shown separately
You never hand cash to anyone
home.fasterNote: We don't promise to speed up government work. We help with the right advice, the right papers and field work.

contact.whatsappText: Hello, I need help with a land matter.

help.title: Tell us your problem
help.intro: Send the form and we'll call you. The first 10-minute call is free, you pay nothing.
help.upazilaHint: For example: Savar, Ashulia, Kaliakair, Sreepur
help.fieldNote: Land surveys and pre-purchase checks are only done in Savar and Gazipur for now. Send the form and we'll add you to the waiting list and tell you when we start in your area.
help.docsHint: Tick the ones you have. Don't send photos of papers here; we'll ask for them on WhatsApp later.
help.descriptionHint: Optional. We'll understand on the call.
help.name: Your name
help.privacy: We only keep your name, phone number and the problem details. We don't share them with anyone.

mouza.too_long: Keep the mouza name under 60 characters

name.invalid: Name must be at least 2 characters

phone.invalid: Enter a valid mobile number, for example 01712-345678

contact_pref.required: Choose how we should contact you

formErrors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in an hour, or call us directly.
formErrors.unavailable: The form isn't working right now. Please call or message us on WhatsApp.
formErrors.unknown: Something went wrong. Try again, or call us directly.

thanks.title: Thank you, we've received it
thanks.refHint: Keep this number. Mention it on a call or WhatsApp and we'll find your case quickly.
next: On a free 10-minute call we'll understand the problem
If needed, we'll send a fixed-price offer; you pay only if you agree
thanks.waitlistBody: Field work hasn't started in your area yet. We'll call you when it does. Meanwhile, call us if you'd like advice by phone.
thanks.cashWarning: No one from LandDoctor will ever ask you for cash in hand. If anyone does, tell us.

legal.draftNote: This text has not yet been reviewed by a lawyer.

footer.note: LandDoctor is not a government office.

offer.title: Our offer for you
offer.payNote: By bKash, Nagad, Rocket or card. LandDoctor holds the money; the expert is paid after delivery.
offer.cash: Never pay an expert in cash. If anyone asks, tell us.
offer.manualBody: Online payment is coming soon. For now, call or message us on WhatsApp with your case number to pay.
offer.unconfirmedTitle: Call us to confirm the price
offer.unconfirmedBody: The price for this offer isn't final yet. Please call or message us before paying.
offer.expiredBody: Call or message us with your case number for a new offer.
offer.paidBody: Thank you. Your expert will start the work and we'll keep in touch.

success.title: Payment successful
success.body: Thank you. We'll be in touch soon about your case.

fail.title: Payment didn't go through
fail.body: No money was taken. Try again from your offer link, or call us.

cancel.title: You cancelled the payment
cancel.body: You can pay any time from your offer link.

review.title: We're checking your payment
review.body: If money was taken, don't worry: we're verifying it and will call you.

error.title: Couldn't start the payment
error.body: Please call or message us on WhatsApp and we'll help.
